title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS – 1997 An analysis of the expenses made on prison inmates in the various States/UTs reveal that maximum amount was spent mainly on providing food for inmates. Uttar Pradesh (Rs.1293.08 lakhs), Andhra Pradesh (Rs.826.06 lakhs), Madhya Pradesh (Rs.797.9 lakhs), Maharashtra (Rs.596.23 lakhs), Orissa (Rs.470.87 lakhs), Karnataka (Rs.458.13 lakhs) and Punjab (Rs.450.32 lakhs) spent a larger quantum of their resources under this head.
